Seven comments

Two Days to Go

Diarmaid Moynihan’s composition. Originally posted in Chris Corrigan’s home page.

↳ Posted by slainte on June 17th, 2002.

Original version

I transcribed this direct from the recording:

X: 1
T: Two Days To Go
C: Diarmuid Moynihan
M: 4/4
L: 1/8
R: reel
K: Gmaj
~G3d eGEG|dedB AdBA|G2dg eGBd|eGdG (3cBA BA| or dBAB AGEA|
GDEG d3e|dDBd AGEG|(3DEG DB AGGd|1 dGAB ADBA:|2 dGAB AG~G2||
|:b2ag ag2d|eGeg edBd|d2bg ag2d|eG (3deg ~a3b|
abgb ag~g2|eGdB AGEG|EDGB AGGd|1 dGAB AG~G2:|2 dGAB ADBA||

A couple of variations for bar 4: |dBAB AGEA| or |eddB ADBA|

Not one of my favourite tunes, I have to say. I find it to be very twee-sounding, and that jazzy improvised bit at the end is even more annoying than the tune itself…

Live version at Big Whistle Festival Feb 2013

This transcription is from a live recording of Hamish Napier & Marc Duff from a concert at the Big Whistle Festival in Feb 2013. Hamish Napier was playing a Low F whistle. The recording can be found at http://www.hamishnapier.com/projects/marc-duff-hamish-napier-duo/. One of my favourite tunes on a Low F.

↳ Posted by Mikethebook on December 15th, 2013.

Michael Murphy’s

I transcribed this reel from Scottish guitarist/singer/mandolinist Calum McIlroy’s 2020 album This Ill Deeds, in which he notes he learned it from flute player Tiernan Courell. I haven’t been able to find another name for this tune or a matching melody on the site but please let me know if it’s already been posted!

↳ Posted by ccmando on November 8th, 2024.

The original link is thesession.org/tunes/781
